shortDescription: List and filter on Linode Managed Databases.

options.name: count
options.description: The number of results to return. If undefined, all results will be returned.

options.name: filters
options.description: A list of filters to apply to the resulting databases.

options.name: order
options.description: The order to list databases in.

options.name: order_by
options.description: The attribute to order databases by.
